name: Blasphemous Edict
clause: You may pay {B} rather than pay ~'s mana cost if there are thirteen or more creatures on the battlefield.

needs.semantics: The AltCost TYPE can express it (mana cost plus a condition), but COVER_RULES.altCosts' pitch shape is anchored right after "mana cost" so the trailing condition breaks the match, and its value check accepts only 'pay N life' / 'exile … from your hand', not a mana payment. The second line is already parsed — this is a cover-rule gap, not a vocabulary gap.
